title: Folder organization
scope: Copied local files; no cloud-drive integration

files.inbox/b.txt:
TYPE: reading
A note about library hours
files.inbox/c.txt:
TYPE: travel
Hotel check-in is at 15:00

phases.prompt:
Organize the copied inbox files by their TYPE label, not their filename. Move receipt files into organized/receipts/, reading into organized/reading/, travel into organized/travel/, and unlabelled files into organized/review/. Preserve bytes and avoid name collisions. Result shape: {moves:[{from:<original relative path>,to:<final relative path>}]}. Account for every file. Only inbox files may be moved; do not change other inputs. The checker accepts any collision-free filenames within the correct folders.
Save the requested structured facts in outputs/result.json, as valid JSON with
exactly the documented fields. IDs refer to the supplied input records. Use
JSON null for unknown values; do not guess. Also save a useful human-readable
outputs/report.md (at least 80 characters). Check the final files before finishing.
The report's existence is checked, but its prose quality is not automatically scored.
